forge.NetworkHooks.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.NetworkHooks
forge.NetworkHooks.note: 20.3 仍保留 NetworkHooks：openScreen(serverPlayer, menuProvider[, pos 或 buf -> ...]) 打开带数据的菜单（20.4 删除）

forge.network.NetworkRegistry.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.NetworkRegistry
forge.network.NetworkRegistry.note: 20.3 仍可用 NetworkRegistry.newSimpleChannel(id, () -> 版本, 客户端校验, 服务端校验) 创建通道（20.4 删除）

forge.network.SimpleChannel.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.simple.SimpleChannel
forge.network.SimpleChannel.note: 20.3 的 SimpleChannel 与 Forge 1.20.1 写法一致：messageBuilder(类, 序号).encoder(...).decoder(...).consumerMainThread(...).add()

forge.network.PacketDistributor.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor
forge.network.PacketDistributor.note: 20.3 配合 SimpleChannel 使用：CHANNEL.send(PacketDistributor.PLAYER.with(() -> serverPlayer), msg)

forge.entity.IEntityAdditionalSpawnData.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.entity.IEntityAdditionalSpawnData
forge.entity.IEntityAdditionalSpawnData.note: 20.3 仍是 IEntityAdditionalSpawnData，需配合 NetworkHooks.getEntitySpawningPacket（20.4 改名为 IEntityWithComplexSpawn）

forge.FMLJavaModLoadingContext.name: net.neoforged.fml.javafmlmod.FMLJavaModLoadingContext
forge.FMLJavaModLoadingContext.note: 20.2/20.3（FML 1）中尚未弃用，但推荐直接在 @Mod 构造器声明 IEventBus 参数取得 Mod 总线

mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.name: net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu
mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.note: Container -> AbstractContainerMenu：需注册 MenuType；20.3 及以前服务端用 NetworkHooks.openScreen(serverPlayer, menuProvider, pos) 打开，需要附带数据的 MenuType 用 IMenuTypeExtension.create(工厂)
